title: Installing Python
overview: Python can be installed from the official Python website. Installing Python also provides tools like the Python interpreter and package manager pip.

example.title: Check Python Installation
example.content:
Open terminal:

python --version

Example output:
Python 3.x.x

title: Python Interpreter
overview: The Python interpreter executes Python code line by line. It converts Python instructions into actions performed by the computer.

title: Installing Packages with pip
overview: pip is Python's package manager used to install external libraries and frameworks required for development.

example.title: pip Example
example.content:
Install package:

pip install package_name

Example:
pip install requests

title: Python Development Environment
overview: Developers use code editors and IDEs to write Python programs. Popular choices include VS Code, PyCharm, and Jupyter Notebook.

example.title: Common Tools
example.content:
✔ VS Code
✔ PyCharm
✔ Jupyter Notebook
✔ Python Extension

title: Running a Python File
overview: Python programs are stored with the .py extension. These files can be executed using the Python interpreter.

example.title: Run Python File
example.content:
Create:
app.py

Code:
print('Hello Python')

Run:
python app.py
